state:
**Goal `ext-image`, Stage 4 (the pipeline) is under way.** The design is settled by ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; no session re-decides one.

The image component is embedded, typed into every compile and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). `run` decodes JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF and JPEG XL inside the guest under the cap (`extensions/image/src/decode.rs` module doc), applies the EXIF orientation of the formats `image` decodes when `autoOrient` is set, and encodes JPEG, PNG, lossless WebP and GIF (`extensions/image/src/encode.rs` module doc). Metadata is dropped unless a `metadata({keep: true})` step keeps the EXIF block, whose orientation tag is reset to `1` when it was applied (`rule:core-classes/image-correct-by-default`). Lossy WebP and AVIF encoding return `runtime`.

`crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_pipeline.rs` exists and its four orientation and GPS tests pass; the tagged JPEGs are built in the test (`extensions/image/fixtures/README.md`). The guest's `run` still honours only `format` and `metadata` steps, `variants` returns `runtime`, and the `Novis\Image` builder (Novis source half) does not exist.

items.text: **Encoders for the first wave** (`rule:core-classes/image-format-roster`) — lossy WebP through the prebuilt libwebp and AVIF through `ravif` replace the two `runtime` arms at `extensions/image/src/encode.rs:58`; `jpeg-encoder` per the standing decisions may replace `image`'s JPEG encoder. Add `every_encoder_writes_its_format_and_the_result_reopens` and `lossy_webp_is_encoded_by_libwebp` to `crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_pipeline.rs`.

**`variants` decodes once and runs each plan** (`rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`) — `extensions/image/src/lib.rs:225` returns `runtime` today; decode once with `crate::decode` and call `crate::encode` per plan. Tests `variants_with_three_entries_costs_one_crossing` and `encode_costs_one_crossing` count host-to-guest calls.

**CMYK with an ICC profile to sRGB** (`rule:core-classes/image-correct-by-default`) — `moxcms` per the standing decisions, in `extensions/image/src/decode.rs:115`; a CMYK fixture whose profile allows redistribution, named in `extensions/image/fixtures/README.md`. Tests `a_cmyk_jpeg_with_a_profile_resizes_to_the_reference_colours_not_inverted` and `to_srgb_false_keeps_the_raw_channels`.

backlog: The pixel steps (resize, crop, rotate, …) in the guest's `run`, then the `Novis\Image` builder and the five Stage 4 `.nvst` cases (`rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`).
AVIF `irot`/`imir` and JPEG XL orientation are not applied by `extensions/image/src/decode.rs` (`rule:core-classes/image-correct-by-default`).
